title: Roles Matrix + Bulk Assignment flow: RBAC v2 Console UX
creator: Samir Patel
description: Problem: The Console needs a clear, scalable UI for RBAC v2 so admins can create/edit roles, preview effective permissions (including inherited and SSO-group mappings), and perform bulk member assignments without risking accidental over-permissioning. This ticket covers the UI flows and interaction patterns for: roles matrix view, role editor (granular toggles + inheritance preview), member bulk assignment modal, and in-line audit/logging cues. Scope excludes backend API design and DB schema but must call out required fields and events for audit logs and SSO group sync hooks.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Roles matrix view shows roles as rows, permission categories as columns, and an explicit indicator for inherited vs explicit grants.

A2: Role editor supports: name/description, category-scoped permission toggles, multi-select shortcuts (enable all read, disable all write), and a live ‘effective permissions’ preview reflecting role composition and inherited roles.

A3: Bulk member assignment modal supports: paste/email list, SSO group selection, preview of delta (permissions users will gain/lose), conflict detection (existing roles, org-level restrictions), and a dry-run export (CSV) before commit.

A4: Every change (role create/update/delete, bulk assign/unassign) emits an auditable event string containing actor, timestamp, before/after deltas, and source (UI vs SSO sync). The UI surfaces a short-form audit summary after operations with link to full audit log entry.
A5: Accessibility: all controls keyboard-focusable, toggles have ARIA labels, color contrast meets AA, and bulk modal supports screen-reader announcements for preview results.

A6: Usability: Undo snackbar for bulk operations (10s), progressive disclosure for advanced options (inheritance, conditional grants), and confirmation gates for changes that increase permission scope beyond threshold.
A7: Design handoff includes Figma frames, interaction specs, and a list of required API payloads/events for engineering and security review.
decisions: D1: Matrix-first entry point — show roles matrix as primary landing for /settings/access to help admins get a high-level audit view.
D2: Inheritance indicator uses a 3-state chip: Explicit / Inherited (from role X) / Denied. Hover reveals source role(s).
D3: Bulk assignment will default to 'preview only' on first use with an explicit checkbox to commit, to reduce accidental grants.
D4: SSO group mapping appears as a contextual dropdown in the member modal; sync operations are labeled and produce separate audit events.
D5: For scalability, permission columns will be grouped and collapsible (e.g., API, Console, Deploy) and support search/filter within matrix.
tasks: T1: Create high-fidelity Figma frames for matrix landing, role editor panel, and bulk assignment modal (Luisa).
T2: Write interaction spec for effective-permissions preview and hover states (Luisa).
T3: Capture backend event schema required for audit logs and provide example payloads (ask Eng: Priya Rao).
T4: Accessibility pass and keyboard flows (Luisa + Accessibility SME).
T5: Usability test with 5 internal admins using synthetic orgs to validate preview/delta comprehension (Research).
T6: Handoff package to engineering including Figma, tokens, motion specs, and acceptance criteria (Luisa).
T7: Coordinate security review for confirmation gates and audit event contents (Security team).
T8: Add companion microcopy for confirmation dialogs and audit summaries (Content Designer).
T9: Add instrumentation hooks for telemetry on number of bulk assigns and error rates (observability).
